title: Draft International Declaration of Human Rights — Mexico, Chile, Venezuela: Amendment to article 6 of the draft Declaration (E/800)

pages.text:
United Nations                    Nations Unies
GENERAL ASSEMBLY                  ASSEMBLEE GENERALE

UNRESTRICTED
A/C.3/309/Rev.1
25 October 1948
FRENCH ONLY

Dual distribution

Third session
THIRD COMMITTEE

DRAFT INTERNATIONAL DECLARATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS

Mexico, Chile, Venezuela: Amendment to article 6 of the draft Declaration (E/800)

Add to article 6 a second paragraph worded as follows:

"Everyone has the right to an effective remedy before the competent national courts against acts violating the fundamental rights recognized to him by the constitution or by law."

-------

[Footnote: * The present text cancels and replaces the French text of document A/C.3/309]

issues.french: les droits fondamentaux qui lui sont reconnus par la constitution ou par la loi
issues.translation: the fundamental rights granted to him by the constitution or by law
issues.suggestion: "the fundamental rights recognized to him by the constitution or by law" (reconnus = recognized; "granted" echoes the final UDHR Article 8 wording rather than this French text). Meaning is close, so this is only a wording point.
